commitMessage: chore: record Qwen CUDA correctness milestone and memory
notes: Implemented segment splitting for value-key ops (range, create) in buildSegments(). These 2 ops out of 2742 are now isolated into non-capturable segments, allowing remaining ~2740 ops to use CUDA graph replay. Previously ALL ops fell back to slot-by-slot (4.12 tok/s) because value-key mismatch detected every decode step. Fix is in NativeDynamicShapePlan.cpp isSlotCapturable lambda. Not yet built/tested. Also includes: MmulHelper mixed-type GEMV fix, causal mask pre-unmask, onnx_mha syncToDevice, GenerationPipeline VLM decode embedding lookup.
